name: How long does a typical home remodeling project take with project management?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home remodeling project take with project management?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home remodeling project with project management varies significantly based on the scope and complexity. A small bathroom remodel might take a few weeks, while a major whole-home renovation could span several months. During the initial planning phase, Frasheski Construction will provide a detailed timeline specific to your project, accounting for design, material procurement, permitting, and construction phases. Our project management aims to keep the project on schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope, but we provide a detailed timeline during planning to keep your remodel on track.
